text: Experiment 4 (2026-11-11), mock inject-and-recover. 27 mocks from one 14-bin SFH (M1_210210 baseline medians), truth [α/Fe]=+0.2, [Fe/H]=−0.2, mass-weighted age 3.59 Gyr, C/Fe ∈ {0, +0.15, +0.30}, N/Fe ∈ {0, +0.30, +0.60}, 3 noise seeds, C/N injected through the alf responses, recovered with the plain grid. Medians over seeds, bias = recovered − truth: no injection: [α/Fe] −0.001, age −0.01 Gyr. C +0.15: [α/Fe] −0.114, age +0.60. C +0.30: [α/Fe] −0.250, age +0.91. N +0.30: [α/Fe] −0.060, age −0.86. N +0.60: [α/Fe] −0.113, age −1.32. C +0.15, N +0.30: [α/Fe] −0.170, age −0.12. C +0.30, N +0.60: [α/Fe] −0.340, age −0.25. [Fe/H] bias rises with N (+0.11 per +0.3 dex). No nonzero pair reproduces the signs of all five M1_210210 band pulls: every C-positive case gives negative G4300 pull; the real pull is +4.2. The mock uses the same response prescription for injection and fitting, one SFH, Mg b in range. Experiment 6 (same mocks; C/N free, Mg b cut, carbon mask) launched 2026-11-11.
